steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: This is the last one...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella! Get down!
A grenade has been thrown toward her. Even if she's heard the warning, the girl can't react fast enough. The explosion is imminent, and right now the only thing that can get to her fast enough is...
You feel a burn in your hand—the shackles! A red light flashes out from Hella. Next, her body tilts in an extremely unnatural way.
She dodges the grenade, but then lands hard on the ground face first. At the same time, Hecate's Nightmare blows away the last enemy.
It's over.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: <size=32>It's the third time</size>... <size=44>The third time, the third time, the third time!</size> I hate that stuff! Never use it on me again!
She sits down and begins grumbling animatedly—but you already know how she's like when she's really angry.

options: Now is not the time for tantrums

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Humph... humph! Don't talk to me! I'm mad!
She slaps away your hand indignantly, gets up on her own, pats off the dust on her butt, then opens the car door with a pout.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Humph! Help me up, idiot!
She grabs your hand and gets up, rubs the dust on you, then opens the car door while mumbling.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That Sinner hasn't caught up with us, and I don't hear any sound from the motorbike.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: That's weird... She was already very close to us, even if she's been slowed down by the gangsters, she should have caught up with us now, given how strong she is.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Maybe she's gone overboard with the speed and fallen over. Don't stress about it, let's get out of here first.
As you're walking toward Hella, a dark shadow suddenly rips through the air between you, piercing the ground—it's a freshly removed sharp iron bar.
Hecate puts herself before you. Over her shoulder, you see a horrifying figure at the corner of the alley that looks like a mad beast.

steps.speaker: Sinner with huge sword
steps.content: Shackles... Those are the shackles...

steps.speaker: Sinner with huge sword
steps.content: That's why she... must... fight...

steps.speaker: Sinner with huge sword
steps.content: ...I'm gonna kill you!
The Nightmare clashes with the aggressor and wards off the first strike.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Run!
Run? Where to?
A chilling vroom of engines bursts out from the corner of the alley. A dozen of motorbikes and pickup trucks of different sizes shoot out from there. It's the Legion.

steps.speaker: Legionnaire
steps.content: ...This is the person the Boss is looking for? Hmm. Seems to know a trick or two.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...We're surrounded. That woman led us here on purpose.

steps.speaker: Legionnaire
steps.content: Now, please come with us, Chi...

steps.speaker: Sinner with huge sword
steps.content: Die!!
The Sinner carrying the huge sword slashes through the Nightmare's shadow, dragging the sword and charging at you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get it together! Get in the car! I'll drive! How come <color=#fb9259>you</color>'re back?!
Behind the car door, the blond driver is sitting in the driver's seat, having just started the engine.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: Because I can't get out of here without the car.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: Close the door, we gotta go!
